description: This Java class 'ChartScrollControl' provides a GUI component for navigating through charts, with previous/next buttons and keyboard shortcuts, interacting with a ChartRepository and a listener.

classes.name: ChartScrollControl
classes.description: A GUI component for scrolling through charts with buttons and keyboard shortcuts, managing chart index and display.

methods.name: ChartScrollControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control with a listener, setting up UI components and key bindings.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Navigate to the previous chart, wrapping to the last if at the beginning.

methods.name: showChart
methods.description: Display the current chart via the listener.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigate to the next chart if available.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Bind left/right arrow keys to navigate charts.

methods.name: setInfoText
methods.description: Update the label with current index and total size.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset index to zero and update display.
